text:
The code has a vendor-neutral `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations` core, with provider implementations under namespaces such as `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead`. The separation is already substantial, but migration from Juno is incomplete.

**Only Instead is registered as an executable adapter.** `FirmSettings::PROVIDERS` contains `juno`, `gruntworx`, and `instead`; an enum entry alone does not provide an integration. Juno remains outside the registry, and GruntWorx has no registered adapter. See [Registry](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/registry.rb:10) and [FirmSettings](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/firm_settings.rb:6).

The vendor-neutral ports cover:

| Area | Core responsibility |
|---|---|
| Authorization and connection | Start authorization, complete connection, read connection/passport, disconnect, renew, verify and revoke grants. |
| Export | Authorize access, validate files against capabilities, prepare the return envelope, create shared send records, then delegate execution. |
| Prefill | Read previous return information and CRM fields without contacting the provider; works while disconnected. |
| Document lifecycle | Shared upload/processing states, failures, broadcasts, resumption after reconnect, reconciliation scheduling, and reusable presigned byte transfer. |
| Cleanup and CRM lifecycle | Delete envelopes and provider data, merge contact-related records, and clean up on firm deactivation/deletion. |

The export boundary is particularly clear: the core passes an envelope and shared send records to the adapter; the adapter owns the vendor-specific workflow. Instead starts its async export workflow after the enclosing transaction commits. See [core export](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:53), [Instead export](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/export_async.rb:28), and [prefill](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/tax_preparation_prefills/find.rb:28).

An adapter plugs in through the static `Registry::ADAPTERS` map: provider symbol → Ruby namespace. `FEATURE_FLAGS` optionally associates a provider with a firm feature flag; no mapping means it is offered to every firm.

The namespace contract is established by actual dispatch sites:

| Required member | How the core calls it |
|---|---|
| `Connection` | `.for_firm(firm)`, `.usable_for(firm)`, `.capabilities`, plus ActiveRecord queries and shared lifecycle scopes. |
| `Client` | `.new(connection)`; common grant operations include `renew!` and `revoke_tokens!`. Presigned transfer also uses `upload_to_signed_target`. |
| `Authorizations::Create` | `.call(user, actor, provider, return_url)` |
| `Connections::Create` | `.call(user, actor, provider, params)`; returns the connection. |
| `ExportAsync` | `.call(user, actor, tax_preparation, tax_automation_documents: records)` |
| `Documents::ReconcileStatusesAsync` | `.call(user, actor, connection, {tax_automation_document_ids: ids})` |
| `DestroyForTaxPreparations` | `.call(user, actor, firm_id, tax_preparations)` |
| `DestroyForFirm` | `.call(user, actor, firm_id)` |
| `MergeForContact` | `.call(user, actor, firm_id, source_contact_id, target_contact_id)` |

These services follow the shared `ServiceResult` convention. The reconciliation member is a real background contract: the sweep iterates registered adapters and dispatches to it. Firm destruction likewise invokes every registered adapter, so historical data does not depend on the firm’s current provider. See [reconciliation dispatch](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_sweep_worker.rb:36) and [cleanup dispatch](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/firms/destroy_cleanup.rb:55).

The current connection/client contract is **OAuth-shaped**. Connection models include `HasOauthConnection` for encrypted credentials and the `disconnected / connected / expired / revoked` state machine. `connected` and `expired` are usable because renewal may recover an expired grant. Instead’s client subclasses `BaseClient`, which includes `TokenRefreshable`; OAuth endpoint and credential differences are declared through `oauth2_settings`. See [connection concern](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/concerns/tax_preparation/tax_automations/has_oauth_connection.rb:23) and [OAuth configuration](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/token_refreshable.rb:63).

The **capability passport** is a typed, class-level description of the vendor, independent of any connection row:

```ruby
Capabilities(
  terms: [
    Terms(return_type:, accepted_file_formats:, max_file_size_mb:)
  ],
  supported_tax_years:
)
```

Terms belong to each return type, allowing different formats and size limits for different forms. Supported return types are derived from those terms. Adapters implement private class methods `capability_terms` and `supported_tax_years`; construction rejects malformed values and duplicate return-type declarations.

The passport drives server-side export validation and the UI contract. Serialization exposes `tax_years` and enriched `return_types` containing code, display name, personal/business family, file types and size limit. Instead currently declares the 11 forms in its entity mapping and dynamically supports the current year plus the preceding two years. See [passport definition](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/has_capabilities.rb:20), [validation](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export/validate_documents.rb:40), and [serialization](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/serializers/tax_preparation/base/tax_automations/connection_serializer.rb:58).

The data model separates shared business state from vendor handles:

| Model | Role and relationships |
|---|---|
| `FirmSettings` | One row per firm; selected provider and external vendor-account binding (`external_tenant_uuid`). |
| Provider `Connection` | OAuth grant, encrypted tokens/expiries, lifecycle timestamps and authorizing member. Instead has one connection per firm. |
| Shared `TaxPreparation` | Return envelope: firm, client, optional contact, year, return type, EIN and business name. Core uniqueness is firm/client/contact/year. |
| Shared `Document` | A TaxDome document sent under an envelope, provider and return type. Unique by firm/envelope/document/provider/return type. Owns upload state, processing state, failure reason and upload timestamp. |
| Instead `Entity` | Vendor taxpayer identity and snapshots; external UUID unique within the firm, entity type, source, linking and synchronization/archive information. |
| Instead `Document` | One-to-one extension of the shared send record; references an Instead entity and stores vendor-specific path/external file UUID. |

Two details matter for future providers:

- **Provider and return type are snapshots on the send record.** Switching providers or changing the envelope does not rewrite historical send identity.
- **The shared envelope still uses the physical `juno_tax_preparations` table.** It retains optional Juno associations and compatibility filtering alongside the new core client/contact columns.

See [shared envelope](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/tax_preparation.rb:11), [shared send record](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:3), [Instead entity](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/entity.rb:55), and [Instead document extension](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/document.rb:6).

For GruntWorx, the existing extension point is therefore a namespace implementing this contract, with its own persistence and execution workflow. Its authentication and processing model would need to fit—or explicitly extend—the current OAuth-oriented connection contract. No files were edited.
